<!-- omgithub:readme:end -->

## Ragdoll Riot

A fast, arcade-style shooting gallery starring toy mannequins and splashes of paint. Open `index.html` in a browser (or serve this folder with a static web server) to play.

- Click or tap the moving dolls to score; head and bullseye hits are worth extra.
- Build a streak for bonus points.
- Reload with **R** or the on-screen reload button.
- Pause with **Esc** or the pause button. Runs last 60 seconds; your best score is saved locally.

All splatter is stylized paint on fictional toy targets.

Built **Ragdoll Riot**, a complete browser shooting-gallery game in `index.html`. Aim and tap or click moving toy dolls, build streaks, reload, and beat your best score in 60-second rounds. It includes pause controls and mobile-friendly layout.

The “gore” is stylized paint splatter on fictional toy targets. Added play instructions to `README.md`.

Checked the game in desktop and mobile browser sizes, including start, pause/resume, and reload. **Assumption:** kept the violence cartoonish rather than graphic.
